description: Covers deep neural network architectures, backpropagation dynamics, convolutional networks, recurrent architectures, transformers, and deep generative models.
learning_objectives: Understand deep neural network fundamentals, loss functions, and backpropagation.
Master optimization and regularization techniques including Adam, BatchNorm, and ResNet skip connections.
Build Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for vision and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs/LSTMs) for sequences.
Explore Transformer self-attention mechanisms, Autoencoders, and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs).
outline: Neural Network Fundamentals: MLPs, activation functions, loss functions, computational graphs, backpropagation.
Optimization & Regularization: SGD, Momentum, Adam, RMSprop, weight decay, dropout, Batch Normalization, Layer Normalization.
Convolutional Networks (CNNs): Convolutions, pooling, architectures (AlexNet, VGG, ResNet, EfficientNet), object detection, segmentation.
Sequence Models (RNNs): Vanilla RNN, LSTM, GRU, sequence-to-sequence models, bidirectional architectures.
Transformers & Self-Attention: Multi-head attention, positional encoding, encoder-decoder architectures (BERT, GPT).
Generative Models: Autoencoders, Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Diffusion models overview.
